headline: Punj Lloyd Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process

detail: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - Punj Lloyd Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process  This is to inform you that in terms of Regulation 32 B of the IBBI (Liquidation Process) Regulations, 2016, the First meeting of the Reconstituted Committee of Creditors (CoC) of Punj Lloyd Ltd. is scheduled to be held on 2nd September 2026 at 11.30 A.M. at L 41, Connaught Circus, Outer Circle, New Delhi - 110001 as well as through audio & visual mode, to discuss wayforward regarding closure of Liquidation process of the Company.
